rust_summary: entities shown to one player's client alone (`native_client_entity_spawn`, `_set`, `_move`, `_remove`), their data from a compound as `/summon` reads it, and an entity id no server entity takes (`native_reserve_entity_id`).
doc_summary: `native_client_entity_spawn(viewer, kind, pos, yaw, nbt)` shows an entity (a text, item or block display, or any type with its custom name, invisibility, glow) to one player's client alone, with its synched data encoded from `nbt` as `/summon` reads it; `native_client_entity_set(viewer, id, nbt)`, `native_client_entity_move(viewer, id, pos, yaw)` and `native_client_entity_remove(viewer, ids)` change, move and take it away. Never simulated, saved or seen by others. `native_reserve_entity_id()` gives an id no server entity takes. Bundles need "hooks": @API:client_entities@.
